title: DnNP: Denoising Input Uncertainty in Neural Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.14424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Processes (NPs) are flexible meta-learning models capable of uncertainty quantification across diverse applications. However, the standard NP framework assumes access to noise-free inputs. This is unrealistic in many practical settings, where sensor noise or measurement errors are unavoidable. This discrepancy between model assumptions and real-world data can significantly degrade prediction quality and uncertainty estimates. We introduce Denoising Neural Processes (DnNPs), a principled extension of the NP framework that explicitly models input uncertainty. We train DnNPs via variational inference. DnNPs jointly learn to denoise corrupted inputs and perform meta-learning, making them robust to noisy training data. We demonstrate DnNPs' effectiveness on both synthetic and real-world datasets, showing consistent improvements in prediction and uncertainty quantification compared to standard NPs. translated_title: DnNP：神经过程中的输入不确定性去噪
translated_abstract: 神经过程（NPs）是灵活的元学习模型，能够在多种应用中进行不确定性量化。然而，标准的NP框架假设输入是无噪声的。这在许多实际场景中并不现实，因为传感器噪声或测量误差是不可避免的。这种模型假设与真实世界数据之间的差异会显著降低预测质量和不确定性估计的效果。我们提出了去噪神经过程（DnNPs），这是NP框架的一个有原则的扩展，能够显式地对输入不确定性进行建模。我们通过变分推断来训练DnNP。DnNP联合学习对受损输入进行去噪并执行元学习，从而对含噪训练数据具有鲁棒性。我们在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上展示了DnNP的有效性，与标准NP相比，在预测和不确定性量化方面均取得了一致的改进。在基于……（原文在此截断）的PM2.5空间插值任务上……
tldr: 提出去噪神经过程（DnNP），通过变分推断显式建模输入不确定性，将去噪与元学习联合训练，从而在含噪数据下显著提升预测质量与不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes Denoising Neural Processes (DnNPs), a principled extension of Neural Processes that explicitly models input uncertainty via variational inference, jointly learning to denoise corrupted inputs and perform meta-learning for improved prediction and uncertainty quantification on noisy data.
